scope: Optional owner-scoped finite treasury inventory credits from reviewed finalized Solana USDC observations into canonical Base Vault Subsidy. No bridge, source signing, automatic swap, consensus proof or automatic source refund.

checks.scope: Global TypeScript after final capacity change
Direct 1.9.1 metadata matches already-installed transitive dependency

established: Startup and invoice readiness verify pinned Solana genesis and the existing initialized classic-SPL treasury ATA before returning a payment URL.

Strict local RPC fixtures cover finalized exact TransferChecked/ref/amount/mint/delta, wrong cluster and ATA, unfinalized or late payment, writable/additional references and global source nonce scope.

Actual Anvil contracts execute real signed EIP-3009 treasury funding once and exact Selection Subsidy; lifetime earned Income remains unchanged and owner withdrawal does not reset source replay protection.

Invoice creation checks actual current/confirmed treasury inventory, cumulative first-initialized finite inventory, unresolved holds and canonical current/confirmed managedExposure capacity before returning a URL.
Real Anvil full Vault cap refuses a new invoice with unchanged journal records. An initially empty treasury refuses journal initialization without creating a zero-budget marker.
Private retained policy/journal/marker binding, concurrency limits, expired holds, restart replay, original source/signature/raw hash/nonce and lost delivery before/after broadcast are enforced.
Original-byte explicit rebroadcast recovers the pre-broadcast crash without a renewed authorization, fee or nonce. Real EVM reorg clears credited anchors and retains unresolved capacity.

Exact signed-gas simulation rejects under-gassed actual Vault execution before retaining a relay claim. Wrong treasury signature, destination, controller relay and contradictory source reuse fail closed.
Actual direct token consumption sends money to the intended Vault but lacks required classification; it is held as consumed/unclassified and cannot produce a false credit or new authorization.

Actual configured controller startup/HTTP exercises private hash pins, authenticated human owner, Origin, duplicate JSON, 8 KiB limit and the full five-second streamed-body deadline without moving funds.
Startup excludes senders retained by disabled x402, Platform and legacy transaction modules before a separate inventory journal is created; retained sender/raw inventories have a 4096-entry bound.
limits: The source RPC is a reviewed observation provider, not a consensus verifier or Solana light client. No live Solana payment or public funded Base credit was submitted.

Only narrow legacy classic-SPL TransferChecked transfers with a pre-existing treasury ATA are supported; incompatible wallets, versioned transactions, CPI-only payments and oversized blocks require explicit operator handling.

A source transfer and Base credit are not atomic. Late, ambiguous, unsupported, expired-policy or reverted outcomes retain state and can require separately authorized manual reconciliation or source refund.

Historical Vault uses TransferWithAuthorization and has the documented ERC-3009 wrapper front-running workflow limitation. A prevention requires a separately reviewed ReceiveWithAuthorization Vault version; no historical Vault bytecode was changed.
External EOA treasury and dedicated relayer signatures are required. This module contains no signing key, transaction fee renewal, Safe-signature port or automatic replacement transaction.

The private journal is bounded crash/concurrency storage, not rollback-proof storage. Retain journal, initialized marker and policy separately from the controller database backup; a stale crash lock needs confirmed operator recovery.
Supplier registration/discovery, network-token inventory/rebalancing, executable external leases, supplier metering and production custody/availability acceptance remain separate M6 work.
This focused report is not whole-backend or Linux acceptance and does not establish a project-wide completion percentage.

priorFailure.cause: Four source tests passed and five Anvil cases failed because a fixture faucet had not reached the existing confirmation depth. The fixture now mines confirmations+1 before initialization; production finality depth was unchanged.
